authority_notes: All 80 legacy Methods and all 22 bounded new Methods are preserved from the authenticated v0.3 parent.
Primary Method remains the sole future AP-routing authority; compatibility never grants AP.
Stamina, Qi, and Resonance remain separately tracked with no generic conversion.
The v0.3 exhaustive Method–Foundation pair matrix is deprecated and absent from operative authority.
Compatibility is resolved from generalized Method and Foundation traits plus rare directly authored named overrides.
Foundation v0.4C controls; Mud Lotus Dantian and Glass Heart Meridian are usable with standardized repair practices.
METHOD-100 remains distinct from METHOD-017; METHOD-102 receives no invented balancing restriction.
Repair, Foundation Challenge, transformation, vulnerability, acquisition, self-risk, and ordinary compatibility surfaces are separate.
MET1R3 makes ordinary compatibility polarity-aware and authority-surface-aware.
Every resolver-consumed scoring trait requires eligible positive provenance from its dedicated semantic surface.
Negative breakthrough clauses are directional-strain-only; corrective clauses are correction-only; acquisition and usage remain non-scoring context.
